_comment: Vidulum App asset config for nuChain + wWTX. Vidulum is a multi-asset Cosmos-capable wallet; this registers nuChain so users can hold NU and receive WTX bridged in as wWTX, then IBC it across Cosmos.

bridgedAssets.name: Wrapped WTX
bridgedAssets.note: Lock WTX on WATTx -> mint wWTX on nuChain -> IBC across Cosmos. Burn wWTX to withdraw WTX home.

_endpoints_note: DNS placeholders under nucash.dev — swap for real hosts at public testnet launch; local dev uses 127.0.0.1:26657 / :1317 / :18545.
